title: Fades, translucent
text:
Fades, translucent. I was very underwhelmed by this product. Since it boasted being greaseproof, I assumed these papers had a little more than the average liner. I thought they were going to be more like the Reynolds liners that the colors stay nice and bright and bold. Wrong. Not only is the color more translucent than expected. The liner's color faded when baking. I accidentally put two in a pan and you could really tell a big difference between the color difference in a liner that had been baked and one that hadn't. It says on package "approx. 40 liners" - my pack had 38 - was fine for me but may affect someone that needs exactly 40. Please do not order these if you are doing chocolate cake - they won't look good.

The one positive... they fit my cupcake pan perfectly. Most fold a little - I hate that!
